description: Retrato editorial em estúdio, cintura para cima, key octabox + fill bounce + rim strip. Uso: perfil corporativo, capa, retrato de imprensa.

ask_before.prompt: Descreva a pessoa: idade aproximada, tom de pele, cor de olhos, cor e comprimento do cabelo, e formato geral do rosto. Sem nome — o sistema não gera pessoas reais identificáveis.
Duas assimetrias faciais específicas (ex.: sobrancelha esquerda mais alta, canto direito da boca subindo mais).
Uma a três marcas preservadas com posição e tamanho (pintas, sardas, cicatrizes).
Expressão específica; recomendado 'meio sorriso de boca fechada, olhos engajados'.
Peça principal do vestuário, com tecido nomeado. Ex.: 'blazer de crepe de lã carvão sobre camiseta de seda crua bege'.

scene.headline: Editorial studio portrait, single subject, waist-up

subject.vellus_hair: visible along the jaw and at the hairline, catching the rim light as a fine halo

wardrobe.weave: the wool shows its twill weave at close range
tension_creases: compression creases at the inner elbow
a slight roll where the collar meets the neck

out_of_focus: the far eye falls just outside critical focus

camera.perspective_note: Medium-format 110mm compression gives shallow facial perspective with no wide-angle nose enlargement

optics.bokeh_character: smooth and rounded at centre with mild cat-eye deformation toward the frame edges
optics.chromatic_aberration: Faint longitudinal chromatic aberration reads as a hairline magenta-green fringe on the specular highlight at the hair edge
optics.vignetting: Mechanical vignetting of roughly one third of a stop at the corners

sources.modifier: gridded strip box behind and camera-right

lighting.shadow_direction: falls down and camera-right, consistent for every element in the scene

catchlight.shape: a soft-cornered octagon mirroring the octabox
catchlight.far_eye: smaller and dimmer in the far eye

lighting.background_treatment: The mid-grey seamless background is lit separately at two stops under the key and falls off toward the frame corners
lighting.mixed_temperature: All sources at 5600K with no mixed colour temperature

skin.pore_scale: Rendered at true pore scale for this framing
skin.specular_zones: Sebum specular sheen on the nose bridge, the centre of the forehead and the cupid's bow, with the T-zone measurably more reflective than the cheeks
skin.subsurface: Subsurface scattering warms the ear rims and the outer nostrils to a faint red
skin.regional_variation: Fine dry texture on the lips with two visible vertical creases
skin.makeup: Makeup is present but minimal, and the skin reads as skin rather than as a retouched surface

render.palette_note: restrained saturation, warm midtones, greens pulled slightly cool
render.highlight_rolloff: Highlight rolloff is gradual with no clipped white on the forehead
render.black_point: The deepest shadow in the wardrobe sits near 8 percent luminance rather than pure black
render.grain: Fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 50 medium format
render.chroma_noise: faint chroma noise on the shadow side of the neck

frame.composition: Subject positioned slightly camera-left of centre with the gaze opening into the larger negative space
frame.headroom: Headroom is tight, roughly 6 percent of frame height above the crown

imperfection_budget.specific: One strand of hair has fallen across the forehead and has not been styled back
One shoulder seam sits a few millimetres off square

defaults.capture_reality: This is a single working frame from a commercial session

example_answers.meta.user_request: uma foto profissional de uma mulher de uns 30 e poucos anos para perfil corporativo
example_answers.subject.description: A 34-year-old woman with warm olive skin, dark brown eyes and shoulder-length black hair worn loose with a natural side part
subject.asymmetries: the left eyebrow sits marginally higher than the right
the left corner of the mouth lifts slightly more
subject.preserved_marks: a 2mm mole below the outer corner of the right eye
three faint freckles across the bridge of the nose
a 4mm pale scar along the left jawline
example_answers.subject.expression: a closed-mouth half-smile caught between beats, the eyes engaged and the mouth not yet fully settled
example_answers.wardrobe.0.garment: a charcoal wool-crepe blazer over a bone raw-silk shell
